title: question
description: A session asks one question. The target (to) gives the direction: the user, the parent or a child. The options are suggestions: the receiver answers in free text.

context.description: Why the question comes up now, and what the receiver needs to know to answer.

snippet.description: Code or text that shows the problem. Optional.

recommendation.description: Your pick and its reason. Optional.

risk.description: The policy level of this question. Required when defaultOption is present.

defaultOption.description: The option that applies if nobody answers in time. Optional: with no default, the session waits for an answer.

waitSeconds.description: 0: return PENDING at once. More than 0: block up to this many seconds.
